description: Some ColorSpaces can reference other ColorSpaces, and since it's fairly common for many pages to use the same ColorSpaces (see e.g. `issue17061.pdf`) this can help reduce a lot of unnecessary re-parsing especially for e.g. `ICCBased` ColorSpaces.

comments.body:
Wdyt about slightly changing the the #parse, #subparse arguments into (cs, options) ?
In the different calls to these functions only the cs is changing and the other ones are constant.
Nice idea, I've implemented that in a separate commit.
